sourceText:
Lemon Butter Garlic Prawns
By: Blackswan
Published: Sunday, October 4, 2015 - 7:00am

Ingredients




250g medium Prawns
3-4 sprigs of fresh Parsley (chopped)
1 tbsp Butter ½ tbsp Olive oil
1 tsp minced Garlic
½ Lemon Dash of Salt
For Succulent Prawns: 2 tsp Baking Soda Ice Water for soaking prawns

Preparation

1 Remove shells and whiskers. Devein prawns and rinse thoroughly. 2 To achieve a crunchy texture, soak prawns in chilled baking soda mixture for at least 30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. You can also massage the prawns with baking soda and rinse it off after about 30 minutes. 3 Heat oil and butter, sautéed garlic till fragrant and add prawns. 4 Stir fry shellfish till they turn pink. Turn off fire and add chopped parsley and lemon juice. 5 Enjoy your Succulent Lemon Butter Garlic Prawns!

About

The scent of the garlic sautéing in butter and olive oil as fresh prawns danced merrily with parsley herbs, it's simple cooking at its best!
